title: Health Equity Radar — common indicator schema for WHO STEPS cross-country proof of concept
note: Built from the public WHO NCD Microdata Repository data dictionaries and official reports only. No individual records. Use of the WHO public-use datasets is for non-commercial, not-for-profit public health research and demonstration.

VNM.urban_rural: not in the public-use file (strata combine urban/rural × area type; strata are not provinces)

TLS.pa_module: reduced module (px1–px6: vigorous and moderate activity only)

UGA.urban_rural: urban_rural variable present; region variable present but not used for ranking

KOR.survey: Korea Community Health Survey (KDCA), 258 survey units
KOR.note: Comparable public-health concept with different national data sources — self-reported, adults 19+, standardized rates; shown as the median of 258 survey units, never ranked against other countries.

design.variance: Taylor linearization, with-replacement PSU approximation; strata with a single PSU are centred on the overall mean

indicators.name: Current tobacco smoking
indicators.rule: t1 == 1 among valid t1 (1 = yes, 2 = no)

VNM.harmonization: same definition; the official headline is for ages 15+ (separate 15+ weight), so 18–69 can only be checked against overlapping age bands
VNM.label: current smoking

korea.definition: self-reported current smoking, lifetime ≥5 packs, adults 19+

indicators.name: Insufficient physical activity
indicators.rule: total MET-minutes/week < 600; minutes per day capped per STEPS cleaning (days 1–7, ≤ 16 h/day per domain); 'no' answers count as 0

TLS.harmonization: approximate — reduced module; the report's executive summary uses a different definition (<150 min moderate/week, 35.7%) from its annex table (2.4%)

korea.definition: self-reported, different questionnaire and threshold — concept only

indicators.name: Overweight or obesity (BMI ≥ 25)
indicators.rule: measured height m11 (cm) and weight m12 (kg); BMI = kg/m²; pregnant women (m8 == 1) excluded; BMI kept in 14–60

TLS.harmonization: same; report narrative (21.5%) and annex table (17.9%) differ

korea.definition: self-reported height and weight — measured vs self-reported differ

indicators.name: Raised blood pressure
indicators.rule: SBP ≥ 140 and/or DBP ≥ 90 mmHg (mean of readings 2 and 3, STEPS standard; VNM report says mean of three — both tested) or on medication (m7 == 1)

TLS.harmonization: same; annex table row for 18–69 missing — narrative 22.3% used, no CI

indicators.name: Raised fasting blood glucose
indicators.rule: fasting (b1 == 2, did not eat/drink in past 12 h) and fasting glucose ≥ threshold, or on medication for diabetes (h8 == 1 or b6 == 1)

TLS.threshold: report text: capillary ≥ 6.1 mmol/L ('126 mg/dl'); 6.1 mmol/L = 110 mg/dL — both tested
TLS.harmonization: approximate until the threshold is confirmed by reproduction

UGA.threshold: to confirm (7.0 plasma or 6.1 capillary) — both tested

validation_rule: PASS if |reproduced − official| ≤ 1.0 percentage point or the reproduced value lies inside the official 95% CI; otherwise investigate (age, missing, pregnancy, weights, BP averaging, MET cleaning, fasting rule). Indicators that do not pass are not shown with numbers.
